paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The bar chart of performance by different attributes on the 2-retrieval task. For simplicity, we abbreviate the names of all instruct models.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy performance of different language models across five distinct attributes—city, hobby, university, major, and birthdate—on a multi-retrieval task with n=2, as indicated in the chart title. The horizontal axis displays four model variants: Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b, while the vertical axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each model has a grouped set of five colored bars corresponding to the five attributes, as defined in the legend: teal for city, salmon for hobby, periwinkle for university, magenta for major, and lime green for birthdate. For Qwen2.5-7b-1M, all attributes achieve high accuracy, with city and birthdate near 90%, hobby and major slightly lower, and university around 85%. Internlm3-8b shows moderate performance across attributes, with city and birthdate around 70–85%, while university drops to approximately 55%. ProLong-8b performs similarly to Internlm3-8b, with city and hobby near 70%, university around 60%, major at ~30%, and birthdate exceeding 80%. Qwen2.5-7b exhibits significantly lower performance across all attributes, with city, hobby, and major all below 10%, and birthdate reaching approximately 15%. The chart visually emphasizes the performance disparity among models and attributes, with Qwen2.5-7b-1M generally outperforming others, and Qwen2.5-7b showing notably degraded performance, especially on university and major retrieval.
